title: Optimizing alkaline and enzymatic extraction of black bean proteins: a comparative study of kinetics, functionality, and nutritional properties
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,188-203
DOI: 10.1039/D4FB00163J, Paper

This work explores the aqueous and enzyme-assisted extraction of black bean proteins with a focus on extraction yields, kinetics, protein functionality, and in vitro protein digestibility.
